answer_1.quote: We evaluated ACT on a non-factoid QA dataset ... and on TriviaQA ... as well as an open-ended QA dataset ... generating creative outputs using tools like web search APIs ...
answer_1.outputs: textual answers, creative business proposals, open‑ended QA responses

answer_2.quote: We used ROUGE, a common metric for text generation, to assess accuracy. For Trivia Creative Writing we measured recall ...

answer_3.quote: We also employed an LLM-as-a-judge method using ChatGPT-4o mini to assess whether the outputs generated by each method correctly addressed the intended goals of the four agents.

answer_4.quote: Five human experts conducted a consensus‑based assessment on a randomly selected 50% of creative outputs ... evaluators assigned a score of 0.5 to partially correct outputs and 1.0 to completely correct outputs.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators judged alignment of each output with the intended solutions of the four agents, using a two‑point Likert scale (0.5 for partial correctness, 1.0 for full correctness).
